title: Owner returns with Back to Board View and the horizontal and column scroll positions are restored
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List, no layout keys)
Twelve work orders with no lead for a unique customer, each with a line, and the customer has no pinned note
More technician columns than fit the viewport

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View renders with the twelve cards in Unassigned

custom_steps_separated.content: Scroll the board sideways, and scroll the Unassigned column down
custom_steps_separated.expected: Note the first visible technician column and the first visible Unassigned card (neither is the first)

custom_steps_separated.content: Click a visible card
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order's lines page opens

custom_steps_separated.content: Press browser Back
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View renders, data-scroll-restore becomes "applied", and the first visible technician column and Unassigned card are the ones noted

custom_steps_separated.content: Open a visible card again, then open Work Orders from the header link
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Board View opens at top-left (no horizontal offset, Unassigned at its first card) with data-scroll-restore "none"

Back restores both scroll axes of Board View; a fresh navigation starts at the top-left

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Tech View, and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View renders, the twelve rows under Unassigned, and the table scrolls both down and sideways

custom_steps_separated.content: Scroll the table down and sideways
custom_steps_separated.expected: Note the first visible row and the horizontal offset

custom_steps_separated.content: Click a plain cell (Number, or another plain cell when Number is scrolled out of view) of a fully visible row
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order opens

custom_steps_separated.content: Press browser Back
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Tech View renders, data-scroll-restore becomes "applied", and the first visible row and horizontal offset are the ones noted

title: Tech View groups work orders by lead technician and opens one
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (can edit work orders, sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: All tab, no filters, no search, display List, and no Tech View or Board View layout keys (no collapsed groups, pins or Tech View columns)
A throwaway customer with a unique name of at most 30 characters and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
Two eligible lead technicians A and B at this location, resolved over the API
Three work orders for that customer, each with one line: one with lead technician A, one with lead technician B, one with no lead

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders and pick Tech View from the display switcher
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View loads as one table of work orders under technician group headers, Unassigned first

custom_steps_separated.content: Search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Unassigned group header shows a count of 1, and the unassigned work order is the only row under it

custom_steps_separated.content: Bring technician A's group into view
custom_steps_separated.expected: The header shows A's name and a count of 1, and A's work order is the row under it, showing its work order number and the customer name

custom_steps_separated.content: Bring technician B's group into view
custom_steps_separated.expected: The header shows B's name and a count of 1, and B's work order is the row under it

custom_steps_separated.content: Click the unassigned work order's row on its Number or Customer cell
custom_steps_separated.expected:
That work order opens

Tech View lists real work orders under their lead technician's group header, the header counts match the rows, and clicking a row opens that work order

title: Collapse a technician group in Tech View and it stays collapsed after a reload
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: display List, no collapsed groups and no other Tech View or Board View layout keys
A throwaway customer with a unique name of at most 30 characters and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
One work order for that customer, with one line and lead technician A

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders, pick Tech View from the display switcher, and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: Technician A's group shows a count of 1 with the work order as its row, and its control reads Collapse A

custom_steps_separated.content: Collapse technician A's group
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order row leaves the table, A's header stays with its count of 1, and its control reads Expand A

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold at the same URL
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View reopens, and A's group is still collapsed with a count of 1, and the work order row is not shown under it

custom_steps_separated.content: Expand technician A's group
custom_steps_separated.expected:
The work order row is back under A's header

Collapsing a technician group hides its work orders but keeps its header and count; the collapse is restored from the account after a reload; and expanding brings the rows back

title: Pin technicians on Board View and the pins persist
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: display List, no pinned technicians and no other Board View layout keys
At least four eligible technicians at this location, so the two chosen (A and B) do not start in the first two technician positions

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders and pick Board View from the display switcher
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View loads, and neither A nor B is among the first two technician columns after Unassigned

custom_steps_separated.expected: A's pin shows as pressed (Unpin A), and A's column moves directly after Unassigned

custom_steps_separated.content: Pin technician B
custom_steps_separated.expected: B's column sits directly after A's, ahead of every unpinned technician

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold

title: Owner drags a work order to another technician on Board View and clears the outgoing lead shifts
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). Technicians A and B pinned in the saved preference.
A work order for a unique customer with lead technician A and one line authorized for repair.
A whole-work-order shift for A on that work order, tomorrow 05:00 shop time.
A line-level shift for A on the authorized line, tomorrow 07:00 shop time.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is in A's column; A's count is 1 and B's is 0.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the card onto B's column and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The prompt "Clear <A's full name>'s scheduled shifts?" opens with Keep shifts, Clear shifts and Cancel.

custom_steps_separated.content: Click Clear shifts.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The prompt closes, "Lead technician updated" shows, the card is in B's column, and the counts read A 0, B 1.

custom_steps_separated.content: Reload the page cold.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View reopens with the card in B's column.

custom_steps_separated.content: Read A's shifts back.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The whole-work-order shift is gone; the line-level shift still exists, unchanged.

title: Owner reassigns the lead from a Tech View row and clears the outgoing lead shifts
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys); no pinned technicians
A work order for a unique customer with lead technician A and one line authorized for repair
A whole-work-order shift for A on that work order, tomorrow 05:00 shop time
A line-level shift for A on the authorized line, tomorrow 07:00 shop time

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Tech View, and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: The row is in A's group

custom_steps_separated.content: Hover the row, open More actions and choose Reassign lead technician
custom_steps_separated.expected: "Reassign lead technician" opens, listing Unassigned and the eligible technicians, with the current lead A selected

custom_steps_separated.content: Choose B and click Reassign
custom_steps_separated.expected: The prompt "Clear <A's full name>'s scheduled shifts?" opens over the dialog

custom_steps_separated.content: Click Clear shifts
custom_steps_separated.expected: The prompt and the dialog close, "Lead technician updated" shows, and the row is in B's group

custom_steps_separated.content: Reload the page cold
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View reopens with the row in B's group

custom_steps_separated.content: Read A's shifts back
custom_steps_separated.expected:
The whole-work-order shift is gone and the line-level shift remains

Reassigning from the dialog with Clear removes only the outgoing lead's whole-work-order shift, and the change persists

title: Fields to display on Board View apply to the cards and persist
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List), so Board View shows its default fields
A throwaway customer with a unique name and no pinned note, with a vehicle carrying a known VIN
One work order with one line for that customer and vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders, pick Board View from the display switcher, and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order's card shows the customer name and no VIN

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Fields to display
custom_steps_separated.expected: Customer is on and VIN/serial is off

Board View reopens, and the card still shows the VIN and no customer. In Fields to display, Customer is off and VIN/serial is on

Board View field choices apply to the cards immediately and are restored from the account after a reload, and the newly shown field renders the work order's real VIN

title: Tech View has its own saved Column Selection with Assigned Techs
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List), with no Tech View columns saved: Tech View shows its defaults, Service Advisor on and Assigned Techs off. The List's own column selection shows Service Advisor
A throwaway customer with a unique name of at most 30 characters and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
Two eligible technicians A and B. One work order for that customer with one line assigned to technician B, then lead technician A set, so the line keeps B

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders, pick Tech View from the display switcher, and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order is a row under A's group; the table has a Service Advisor column and no Assigned Techs column

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Column Selection and turn on Assigned Techs
custom_steps_separated.expected: An Assigned Techs column appears at once, and the row shows A's avatar first, then B's

custom_steps_separated.content: Turn off Service Advisor
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Service Advisor column leaves the table at once

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold at the same URL
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View reopens; Assigned Techs is still shown with A's avatar first, and Service Advisor is still hidden

custom_steps_separated.content: Pick List from the display switcher and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected:
The List still shows its Service Advisor column

Tech View keeps a Column Selection of its own, saved to the account (Assigned Techs shows the lead first, and both choices survive a reload), while the List columns are left as they were

title: Lines tab shows the technicians scheduled on a line
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Owner (work-order View) on a desktop viewport, at the location the work order belongs to.
A work order for a new customer with no pinned note and no lead technician, with two lines approved for repair (Line 1 and Line 2), neither with a labor technician.
Technician A has a shift on the Schedule that covers Line 2 only, so A is on Line 2's technician roster without a labor task.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the work order's Lines tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Both lines are listed and no New Line dialog opens.

custom_steps_separated.content: Look at Line 2's Labor row.
custom_steps_separated.expected: It shows technician A's full name where it used to say "Unassigned" or "No technicians assigned to this line.", with no badge.

custom_steps_separated.content: Look at Line 1's Labor row.
custom_steps_separated.expected: It still says the line has no technician and does not show A's name.

title: Owner drags a work order card to another technician and then to Unassigned on Board View
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). Technicians A and B pinned; the Line technicians board field on.
A work order for a unique customer, lead technician A, with three lines added in this order: one with no technician, one assigned to technician C, one assigned to A. No shifts for A on it.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is in A's column, its Line technicians shows A then C, and the counts read A 1, B 0.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the card onto B's column and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A drop indicator shows over B; then "Lead technician updated", the card in B's column, counts A 0 and B 1, and Line technicians B then C with A gone.

custom_steps_separated.content: Reload the page cold.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is still in Unassigned, showing only C.

title: Owner reassigns a lead technician on Board View using only the keyboard and focus returns to the board
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (can edit work orders), viewport 1280 px or wider; browser pinned to the fixture workplace
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API, then technicians A and B pinned in that saved preference
A throwaway customer with a unique name and no pinned note
Two work orders for that customer, each with one line, lead technician A, not Invoiced or Paid, and no scheduled shifts
B is an eligible lead technician whose name matches no other technician when searched

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: Unassigned shows 0, A's column shows both cards, B's column shows 0

custom_steps_separated.content: Focus New work order and press Tab
custom_steps_separated.expected: Focus enters the board on the Unassigned column header

custom_steps_separated.content: Press ArrowRight, then ArrowDown
custom_steps_separated.expected: Focus moves to A's column header, then to A's first card

custom_steps_separated.content: Press Tab, then Enter
custom_steps_separated.expected: Focus moves to the card's More actions, and the menu opens with focus on Reassign lead technician

custom_steps_separated.content: Press Enter
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Reassign lead technician dialog opens with the search field focused and A selected

custom_steps_separated.content: Press Escape
custom_steps_separated.expected: The dialog closes, nothing changes, and focus is back on the card's More actions

custom_steps_separated.content: Press Enter twice
custom_steps_separated.expected: The menu and then the dialog reopen, with A selected and the search empty

custom_steps_separated.content: Type B's name, press Tab, then ArrowDown
custom_steps_separated.expected: Only Unassigned and B are listed, and B is selected and focused

custom_steps_separated.content: Press Tab twice to reach Reassign and press Enter
custom_steps_separated.expected: "Lead technician updated" shows, the dialog closes, the card moves to B's column, and the counts read A 1 and B 1

custom_steps_separated.content: Check where focus is
custom_steps_separated.expected: The other card, still in A's column, has focus

custom_steps_separated.content: Reload the page cold
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is in B's column and the other card is still in A's column
